items.headline: Wagner wants FedEx reset
items.text: Johnson Wagner urges the PGA Tour to reset FedEx Cup points before playoffs to increase late-season competition and reduce the advantage for Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy.

items.headline: DeChambeau joins DP World event
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau will play the DP World Tour's Nedbank Golf Challenge in South Africa this December despite remaining a LIV Golf player amid uncertainty around LIV's future.
